run_episode: run a single MARL episode in train or test mode using the EpisodeRunner
setup_episode_runner: setup the EpisodeRunner with scheme, groups, preprocess, and mac for batch creation
reset_episode_runner: reset the EpisodeRunner environment and create a new EpisodeBatch for the next episode
get_env_info: get environment info like state shape, action shape, and n_agents from the EpisodeRunner
log_episode_stats: log episode return mean, return std, and aggregated stats using the EpisodeRunner _log method
